Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Host BAR 777 and other mini games with automated queue management.
Description: A plugin to manage mini game sessions, player queues, and Gil transactions. Use /minigames to open the main window.
Changelog:
- Updated to latest Gamba Where IPC.
- You can now access game settings, discord webhooks without have to start a session.
- You can now have multiple discord webhooks for deathroll tournament and also name each one to avoid confusion.
